phrase.en: the appointment of a new director

description: Appoint a new director of a Hong Kong company, including CDD on the appointee and filing ND2A.
whenToUse: The client wants to add or appoint a new director (not replace an existing director's details). Also use when a director is being replaced: pair it with director resignation.

deadline.rule: File ND2A within 15 days after the appointment

steps.label: Screen against sanctions and PEP lists
File ND2A with the Companies Registry

documents.name: Board written resolution: appointment of director

complianceNotes: File ND2A within 15 days after the appointment takes effect.
The appointee signs the consent to act on ND2A itself, so ND2A goes out in the e-signature pack.
A private company must keep at least one individual director, and individual directors must be 18 or over.
Complete customer due diligence and screening before the appointment takes effect.
If the new director will hold over 25% or otherwise control the company, update the significant controllers register too.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: A director resigns or is removed; file ND2A for the cessation.
whenToUse: A current director is resigning, retiring or being removed. If a replacement is named, also open an appointment.

deadline.rule: File ND2A within 15 days after the resignation

requirements.appliesWhenNote: Only needed if no individual director would remain after the resignation.

steps.label: Check the board still meets minimum requirements
steps.instructions: Confirm at least one individual director remains; if not, open an appointment for the replacement.

steps.label: File ND2A with the Companies Registry
Confirm to client and remind about bank mandates

documents.name: Board written resolution: resignation of director

complianceNotes: File ND2A within 15 days after the resignation takes effect.
The resigning director may also notify the Registrar directly using Form ND4.
Check the company still has at least one individual director after the resignation. If not, a replacement must be appointed at the same time.
Remind the client to update bank signatories and any authorisations the director held.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

phrase.en: the change in an officer's details

description: A director or secretary changes name, address or ID document; file ND2B.
whenToUse: An existing director or secretary has new particulars: a new residential or correspondence address, a new passport or ID number, or a name change.

deadline.rule: File ND2B within 15 days after the change

steps.label: File ND2B with the Companies Registry
Update registers and the KYC record

complianceNotes: File ND2B within 15 days after the change in particulars.

Only the correspondence address and a partial ID number appear on the public register. The residential address and full ID number are protected information, but must still be kept in the company’s records.
A new passport or address also refreshes our KYC record, so update the CDD file at the same time.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Replace the company secretary; file ND2A.
whenToUse: The company wants to change its company secretary, including appointing our firm as secretary.

deadline.rule: File ND2A within 15 days after the change

requirements.appliesWhenNote: The outgoing secretary's resignation, unless they are being removed by the board.

steps.label: File ND2A with the Companies Registry

documents.name: Board written resolution: change of secretary
Form ND2A: secretary appointment and cessation

complianceNotes: File ND2A within 15 days after the change.
An individual secretary must ordinarily reside in Hong Kong. A corporate secretary must have its registered office or a place of business in Hong Kong.
In a private company, a sole director cannot also be the company secretary.
Corporate secretaries providing this as a business need a TCSP licence.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Move the registered office; file NR1.
whenToUse: The company is moving its registered office or wants its registered address changed (including moving it to our address).

deadline.rule: File NR1 within 15 days after the change

requirements.appliesWhenNote: Not needed when the new address is our firm's address.

steps.label: File NR1 with the Companies Registry
Confirm to client with the list of places to update

documents.name: Board written resolution: change of registered office
Form NR1: change of address of registered office

complianceNotes: File NR1 within 15 days after the change.
The registered office must be an address in Hong Kong. A PO box is not accepted.
Check current Companies Registry guidance on whether NR1 also updates the Business Registration Office record, and notify IRD separately if not.
The company name must be displayed at the new office.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Change the company name by special resolution; file NNC2.
whenToUse: The company wants a new English and/or Chinese name.

deadline.rule: File NNC2 within 15 days after the special resolution

steps.label: Check name availability on the Cyber Search Centre
steps.instructions: Search the Companies Register index for identical or too-like names and record the result.

steps.label: File NNC2 with the Companies Registry
Record the certificate of change of name and update records

documents.name: Members’ written special resolution: change of name
Form NNC2: notice of change of company name

complianceNotes: The change needs a special resolution of members, and NNC2 must be filed within 15 days after it is passed.
The new name only takes effect when the Registrar issues the certificate of change of name.
Search the Companies Registry index before the resolution is signed, and hold a backup name.
A new company chop and common seal (if any) will be needed.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

statutoryFees.description: Companies Registry fee for change of name (NNC2)

description: Incorporate a new Hong Kong private company limited by shares with business registration.
whenToUse: The client wants to set up (incorporate, register, form) a new Hong Kong company.

steps.label: Complete CDD, screening and risk rating
Check name availability
steps.instructions: Search the Companies Register index for the proposed names.

steps.label: Set up registers, SCR and share certificates

complianceNotes: NNC1 is filed together with the business registration application, so both certificates issue together.
A private company needs at least one individual director and a company secretary resident in Hong Kong.
CDD on all founders, directors and significant controllers must be completed before we act.
Set up the significant controllers register from day one, and designate a person to deal with enforcement officers.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

statutoryFees.description: Business registration fee and levy, 1 year

phrase.en: moving your company secretarial services to us

description: Take over company secretarial services for an existing company: CDD, engagement, secretary and registered office changes.
whenToUse: A company that is not yet our client wants us to become its company secretary or provide its registered office, or asks us for services and is not yet onboarded. Use for any new client that already has a company.

steps.label: Complete CDD, screening and risk rating
Run a company search and reconcile the registers
steps.instructions: Order a company search on the Cyber Search Centre and compare it with the handed-over registers.

steps.label: Load records and activate the client

documents.name: Board written resolution: appoint secretary, change registered office
Form NR1: change of registered office

complianceNotes: Reconcile the handed-over registers against a fresh company search before relying on them.
Check whether the annual return, SCR and business registration are up to date. Gaps become the client’s first matters.
CDD on directors and significant controllers must be completed before we act.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Prepare and file the annual return (NAR1) for a private company.
whenToUse: The annual return is due, or the client asks about filing its annual return.

deadline.rule: Private company: within 42 days after the anniversary of incorporation

steps.label: File NAR1 and pay the fee

complianceNotes: A private company files NAR1 within 42 days after each anniversary of incorporation.
Late filing attracts a higher registration fee that increases with delay, and can lead to prosecution.
Any unreported changes found during confirmation should be opened as their own matters first.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

phrase.en: the annual accounts approval and AGM

description: Approve the accounts and hold the AGM, or pass written resolutions in lieu.
whenToUse: The AGM or approval of the annual accounts is due, or the client sends audited accounts for approval.

deadline.rule: Private company: within 9 months after the end of the accounting reference period

steps.label: Record the AGM and accounts date

documents.name: Members’ written resolutions in lieu of AGM

complianceNotes: A private company holds its AGM within 9 months after its accounting reference period ends.
Members can pass a written resolution instead of meeting, or unanimously agree to dispense with AGMs.
The auditor must be reappointed each year unless the members resolve otherwise.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Renew the business registration certificate.
whenToUse: The business registration certificate is expiring or the client forwards an IRD demand note.

deadline.rule: Renew before the current certificate expires

steps.label: Pay the fee or forward the demand note

complianceNotes: IRD normally issues a demand note before expiry. Track the expiry date here rather than relying on the post.
Renewal can be for 1 or 3 years.
Branch registrations are renewed together with the main certificate.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

statutoryFees.description: Business registration fee and levy, 1 year (IRD)

phrase.en: our periodic client due diligence review

description: Periodic CDD review of the client and its officers and controllers.
whenToUse: A periodic KYC review is due for the client.

deadline.rule: Firm policy: high risk yearly, medium every 2 years, low every 3 years

steps.label: Re-screen against sanctions and PEP lists

complianceNotes: Review frequency here follows a sample firm policy. Set it to match your own AML policies and procedures.
Keep CDD records for at least 5 years after the business relationship ends.
A change in significant controllers found here should also update the SCR.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Issue new shares to existing or new members; file the return of allotment (NSC1).
whenToUse: The company wants to issue new shares, increase its share capital, or bring in a new shareholder by subscription.

deadline.rule: File NSC1 within one month after the allotment

requirements.appliesWhenNote: For a new member or a significant subscription.
Only for an allottee who is not already a member with current CDD.
Only for an allottee who is not already a member with current CDD.
Only for an allottee who is not already a member with current CDD.
Only for an allottee who is not already a member with current CDD.
Only for an allottee who is not already a member with current CDD.

steps.label: Prepare resolutions, NSC1 and share certificates
File NSC1 with the Companies Registry
Update the register of members and share capital

documents.name: Board written resolution: allotment of shares

complianceNotes: File NSC1 within one month after the allotment.
Directors need members’ approval to allot shares unless an existing general authority covers it (Cap. 622 s.140).
Check whether the allotment creates or changes a significant controller (over 25%) and update the SCR.
Share certificates are due within 2 months after allotment.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Transfer shares between members: instrument of transfer, bought and sold notes, stamp duty, register update.
whenToUse: A shareholder is selling, gifting or transferring shares to someone else.
forms: Instrument of transfer, bought and sold notes (IRD stamping)

deadline.rule: Stamp the instrument within 30 days after execution (2 days for contract notes executed in Hong Kong)

requirements.appliesWhenNote: Only for a transferee who is not already a member with current CDD.
Only for a transferee who is not already a member with current CDD.
Only for a transferee who is not already a member with current CDD.
Only for a transferee who is not already a member with current CDD.
Only for a transferee who is not already a member with current CDD.

steps.label: Prepare instrument, contract notes and board approval
Stamp with the IRD Stamp Office

complianceNotes: Stamp duty on Hong Kong stock is 0.1% of the higher of consideration and value, payable by each of buyer and seller (0.2% in total) since 17 November 2023, plus HK$5 on the instrument.
Contract notes must be stamped within 2 days after execution in Hong Kong (30 days if executed outside); the instrument is stamped after the notes.
Register the transfer and issue a new certificate within 2 months after lodgement.
Update the SCR if control changes.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

phrase.tc: 更新重要控制人登記冊
phrase.sc: 更新重要控制人登记册

description: Keep the significant controllers register (SCR) up to date.
whenToUse: Someone became or stopped being a significant controller (holding over 25% or otherwise controlling the company), or the client says ownership or control has changed.
forms: SCR (kept at the registered office; not filed)

deadline.rule: Update the SCR within 7 days after confirming the particulars

steps.label: Prepare the notice and updated SCR

complianceNotes: The SCR is kept at the registered office or a prescribed place and must be available to law enforcement officers on demand.
Particulars must be confirmed with the controller before entry (Cap. 622 Part 12, Div. 2).
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Deregister a defunct solvent private company: IRD no-objection, then NDR1.
whenToUse: The client wants to close, shut down, dissolve or deregister the company.

steps.label: Apply to the IRD for a notice of no objection
steps.instructions: Submit IR1263 with the fee; wait for the notice.

steps.label: File NDR1 with the Companies Registry

complianceNotes: All members must agree; the company must not have started business or have ceased business for at least 3 months, have no outstanding liabilities, not be a party to legal proceedings, have no immovable property in Hong Kong, and not be a parent of a company with such property (Cap. 622 s.750).
The IRD notice of no objection must accompany NDR1.
Deregistration takes effect on gazettal, about 5 months after the application.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

statutoryFees.description: IRD notice of no objection application

phrase.en: the change of financial year end

description: Change the accounting reference date by directors’ resolution.
whenToUse: The company wants a different financial year end or accounting reference period.

steps.label: Confirm to client, noting the IRD notification

documents.name: Board written resolution: change of accounting reference date

complianceNotes: An accounting reference period cannot exceed 18 months, and the period cannot be extended more than once in 5 years except in limited cases (Cap. 622 s.371).
Notify the IRD of the change of accounting date.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

phrase.en: the nomination of a reserve director

description: Nominate a reserve director for a single-member, single-director private company; file ND5.
whenToUse: A company with one member who is also the sole director wants to nominate a reserve director.

deadline.rule: File ND5 within 15 days after the nomination

steps.label: File ND5 with the Companies Registry

complianceNotes: Only for a private company with one member who is also its sole director (Cap. 622 s.455).
The reserve director must be 18 or over.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Replace the auditor: resignation or removal, consent of the new auditor, resolutions.
whenToUse: The company wants to appoint a new auditor or its auditor is resigning.

documents.name: Members’ written resolution: appointment of auditor

complianceNotes: An outgoing auditor’s resignation must include a statement of circumstances (Cap. 622 s.417).
Removing an auditor before the end of term needs a members’ resolution with special notice.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Amend the articles by special resolution and deliver it to the Registry.
whenToUse: The company wants to change its articles of association or constitution.
forms: Special resolution delivered with a copy of the amended articles

deadline.rule: Deliver the special resolution and amended articles within 15 days

steps.label: Prepare special resolution and amended articles

documents.name: Members’ written special resolution: amendment of articles

complianceNotes: A special resolution needs at least 75% of the votes.
Deliver a copy of the resolution and the amended articles within 15 days (Cap. 622 s.622 and s.90).
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Buy back shares from a member; file NSC2.
whenToUse: The company wants to buy back or redeem shares from a shareholder.

deadline.rule: File NSC2 within 15 days after the shares are delivered to the company

requirements.appliesWhenNote: Only if the buy-back is paid out of capital.

steps.label: File NSC2 with the Companies Registry

documents.name: Form NSC2: return of share buy-back

complianceNotes: A buy-back out of capital needs a solvency statement from every director and a special resolution (Cap. 622 Part 5).
Treasury share rules from 2025 do not change the private company process; verify with the company secretary.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Board resolution to change bank mandates and signatories.
whenToUse: The client wants to add or remove bank account signatories or change the bank mandate.

steps.label: Submit to the bank
steps.instructions: Send the certified resolution with the bank’s mandate form.

complianceNotes: Banks usually require their own mandate form and a certified copy of the resolution.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Declare the company dormant by special resolution (no accounting transactions).
whenToUse: The company has stopped trading and wants to be declared dormant to reduce compliance.
complianceNotes: A dormant company is exempt from preparing audited accounts and holding AGMs, but must still file annual returns.
verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

description: Handle a letter received at the registered office for the client.
whenToUse: The client asks us to forward, scan or deal with mail received at our address.

steps.label: Scan, forward or hold the item

verifyNote: Statutory rule summarised from Companies Registry guidance; verify with the firm's company secretary before relying on it.

whenToUse: Use only when no other playbook fits the request.
complianceNotes: Staff review the planned checklist and fee before anything is sent.
